name: Do accessible bathroom modifications require building permits in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: Do accessible bathroom modifications require building permits in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In communities across the greater Denver area, including Parker, Centennial, and Greenwood Village, bathroom remodels that alter structural framing or shift supply and waste lines require building and plumbing permits. Projects involving doorway widening or relocating drain lines for curbless showers fall under these municipal codes. When you work with HH Remodeling LLC, Abraham oversees the project planning and coordinates qualified plumbing and electrical trade partners to verify that all structural wall changes and rough-in plumbing conform to local building safety codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are generally required if the remodel alters structural wall framing, widens doorways, or moves plumbing drains and electrical lines.
